story_generator.name: Story Generator
story_generator.notes: The Generate / Add to queue button shows a spinner from the click until the song is queued or started, and cannot be pressed twice meanwhile. 0.3.4: AI Recommend adds every style word the AI wrote to the caption that is used. 0.3.3: syllable-level rhyme map (rmap-2), live / dead syllable view; needs pythainlp 5.4.0 or newer.
